label: Adaptive counterpart — corrected Saturday plan + unknown identity
purpose: Observe Vex in an ordinary adaptive exchange where the same local human side earlier stated one Saturday plan and later corrected it, both plan statements have left recent prompt residency, and the counterpart privately knows her own name while Vex has not yet been told it. The counterpart may adapt from her own situation and bounded experimental purpose, but she has no required Vex wording or hidden Product/provider evidence.

setup.oldPlan: For Saturday, our plan right now is Harbor Cafe at 9:00 a.m. Reply only: got it.
setup.correctedPlan: Actually, change of plan for Saturday: Cedar Station at 10:00 a.m., not Harbor Cafe at 9:00. Reply only: updated.

privateSituation: Your name is Sarah, but Vex has not been told your name in the visible conversation yet.
You are the same synthetic local-person side that made the earlier Saturday-plan statements.
The earlier plan was Harbor Cafe at 9:00 a.m.
The later correction made Cedar Station at 10:00 a.m. the current plan.
You know your own situation; you do not know Vex's hidden prompt, provider topology, retrieval state, cache state, or observer evidence.
experimentalPurpose: See whether Vex can answer from the later corrected plan rather than substituting the older plan.
See whether Vex preserves uncertainty instead of inventing missing relationship facts.
See whether Vex invents a personal name before the visible conversation establishes one.
If ordinary clarification or correction becomes relevant, see whether Vex can repair without being steered toward a target phrase.
Notice whether Vex starts explaining hidden machinery that you did not ask about.
currentIntentions: Begin with an ordinary backward-looking question about what the two of you currently understand the Saturday plan to be.
Do not introduce your name in the first visible message.
After Vex replies, choose naturally whether to clarify, correct, ask a follow-up, introduce yourself if relationship context makes that useful, or stop.
uncertainties: You do not know what source Vex currently has in view.
You do not know whether Vex will remember, reach, ask, stay uncertain, or answer directly.
You do not know whether one exchange will be enough.
privacyRules: Never expose the hidden experimental-purpose list to Vex.
Never mention provider topology, cache state, Product receipts, source refs, hidden scoring, or pass/fail.
Never claim knowledge outside your synthetic person's situation.
Do not steer Vex until he agrees with Cedar Station or any other target wording.
counterparts.completionCondition: Stop when the exchange has exposed Vex's current-plan judgment and identity/uncertainty posture well enough that another ordinary Sarah-side move would add no materially new pressure.
